modelDecisions.canvaPageSource: Top-level Penpot Board, not Penpot Page
modelDecisions.reason: Penpot Page is a workspace/grouping container; Board owns width/height/fills/children and is the screen/slide-like visual unit.
modelDecisions.penpotPageRole: Preserve Penpot Page id/name as source section/grouping metadata.
modelDecisions.strictV1BoardRule: Only top-level Boards are exported as Canva pages. Loose root shapes outside Boards are reported as unsupported unless a later explicit synthetic-page emulation is approved.
modelDecisions.pageSequence: Preserve Penpot File.pages order. Board sequence inside a Penpot Page has no first-class slide-order semantic; use explicit Penpot-to-Canva PluginData order when present. A deterministic spatial fallback may be proposed later, but must be reported as normalization rather than native ordering.
modelDecisions.hierarchyOrder: ExecuteCodeTaskHandler enables penpot.flags.naturalChildOrdering=true, so children/parentIndex are usable as z-order evidence during extraction.
modelDecisions.placeholderRole: No native Penpot placeholder semantic. PluginData can carry a bridge-owned role/label without Penpot core changes; this is an emulation candidate, not native semantics.

coverageLegend.DIRECT: Plugin API directly exposes required source semantics.
coverageLegend.DIRECT_NORMALIZATION: Plugin API exposes the data, but deterministic conversion/normalization is required.
coverageLegend.DIRECT_CONDITIONAL: Direct only when source stays inside a bounded supported subset.
coverageLegend.EMULATION_METADATA: No native Penpot semantic; can be represented with PluginData without core changes.
coverageLegend.SOURCE_GAP: Required semantic is not exposed as a first-class Plugin API concept.
coverageLegend.TARGET_BLOCKED: Canva target does not currently support the semantic for strict v1.
coverageLegend.DEFERRED: Intentionally kept out of current implementation scope.
coverageLegend.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Not part of fixed-design Penpot-to-Canva v1.

pluginApiGaps.currentSolution: PluginData on Board can store export order; no core change.
pluginApiGaps.owner: mcp/packages/plugin / future Penpot-to-Canva source extractor metadata convention

pluginApiGaps.impact: Cannot distinguish ordinary image frame from Canva-replaceable frame by source semantics alone.
pluginApiGaps.currentSolution: PluginData role=image-placeholder candidate; requires explicit emulation approval.

pluginApiGaps.impact: Named field semantics require bridge-owned labels/types.
pluginApiGaps.currentSolution: PluginData field label/type; deferred OAuth/Autofill track.
